summary: Bail application after supplementary chargesheet; Section 43D(5) UAPA bail restriction; NIA investigation transfer; Division Bench remand to trial court; substantive change in circumstances; preliminary objection on maintainability; bail not entertained due to new evidence from second supplementary chargesheet; trial court assessment required first; reliance on Basti Ram precedent.
legal_provisions_cited: Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 s.13, s.16, s.17, s.18, s.18B, s.20, s.38, s.39, s.40
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.207, s.439
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's direction to approach trial court for fresh bail application upheld.
